strategy: Freshness-first corridor corroboration + creator-metric contradiction audit + event discovery. Prioritized entities already showing single-source weakness, then searched for independent 2026 evidence instead of maximizing raw result count.

contradictions.statement: Third-party creator indexes disagree on follower count on the same capture date
contradictions.resolution: Preserve both observations with source and timestamp; do not use follower count as an editorial quality score.

dedupe_actions: Kept Exhibition Road as one locality entity and added a second source instead of creating a duplicate corridor record.
Kept @happiness_on_my_plate as one creator and preserved conflicting third-party metrics as metric history.
Kept Saras Mela as the existing event entity; the new Patna Press article is corroborating evidence, not a duplicate event.
product_learnings: Source disagreement should be a first-class data state, especially for creator metrics and dynamic fields.
Corridor confidence should rise through independent source corroboration, not through repeated citations of the same article family.

Event ingestion should distinguish food-centric events from cultural events that may produce food discovery opportunities; the latter belong in a lower-confidence discovery layer until food relevance is established.
